ninePhotos.message: Depop listings can have at most 8 photos.

ninetyNineCents.message: Depop prices must be at least $1.00.

tooLongWithHashtags.message: Depop descriptions, hashtags included, can be at most 1000 characters.

emailAddress.message: Depop doesn't allow email addresses in descriptions.

hashtagLineInCopy.message: Put Depop hashtags in the hashtag list, not on the last line of the description.

sixHashtags.message: Depop listings can have at most 5 hashtags, the description's own included.

badHashtag.message: Depop hashtags are up to 30 letters and numbers each.

unisex.message: Depop needs to know whether the item is menswear, womenswear, or kidswear.

unmappedCategory.message: Depop needs a category for this item.

halfASize.message: Depop sizes need both size_set_id and size_id.

sizeNotANumber.message: Depop's size_id is one whole number.
